title: BST Operations
statement:
Implement an ordinary binary search tree of distinct keys.

Input
q, then q operations ADD x, ERASE x, FLOOR x, or CEIL x. Inserting an existing key or deleting a missing key leaves the set unchanged.

Output
For each query print the greatest key ≤ x or smallest key ≥ x respectively, or NONE.

Constraints
1 ≤ q ≤ 4000. Keys have absolute value at most 10⁹. Operations may arrive in sorted order.

samples.input:
8
ADD 7
ADD 2
ADD 9
FLOOR 8
CEIL 8
ERASE 7
FLOOR 8
CEIL 10
